zip_caveats: This guide covers Boulder and nearby Boulder ZIPs. ZIP codes extend beyond city limits, so city races and city measures apply only if you live in the city. State House districts 10, 12 and 49 overlap the covered ZIP areas. Senate District 18 has no race in 2026. Senate Districts 15 and 17 can apply outside the central city: official ZIP-area and legislative maps show SD-15 in ZIP statistical areas 80301, 80302, 80303, 80304 and 80305, and SD-17 in 80301. HD-12 overlaps 80301, 80302 and 80303. These ZIP-area maps are approximate and do not establish your ballot. Keep those races conditional and confirm them with your official Colorado sample ballot. Boulder’s RTD district is O; if your address is in a different RTD district, check whether it has an election this year. No school-board race or school-district measure appears in the county’s 2026 general-election list.
